This is why the chapter pushes back against the idea that small talk is fake. Early ease is often what makes later depth possible. The lightness is useful precisely because it lowers pressure.

The warning keeps the chapter honest. Mechanical chatter is still dead talk. Script can imitate confidence while removing the curiosity that made the light exchange useful in the first place.
